name: smwmusic-deltarune-ever-higher
title: Deltarune - Ever Higher
description:
The song "Ever Higher" from Chapter 4 of Deltarune, which plays in climbing sections, originally composed by Toby Fox. Would fit in vertical levels, maybe airships too. Could also be fine for overworlds due to its relatively short length?

The original samples were found using stormstudios1's Deltarune Sample Sheet.
